description: FEMA flood zone designation for an address or coordinate. Returns the zone code, plain-English risk, BFE if applicable, FIRM panel reference, and whether NFIP insurance is mandated for federally-backed mortgages.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90, e.g. 29.76.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180, e.g. -95.37.

name: flood_zone_lookup
